text:
beth-sales: EdgeBurst POC perf results landed — attaching the condensed notes we promised. Quick asks: can eng confirm our recommended fallback and queueing behavior for spikes? Also need a short blurb we can give the prospect on expected tail latency for a 256-token generation. cc @sam-eng @akari-eng @maria-se :eyes:

edgeburst-rep: Thanks — ran two profiles yesterday: steady-state traffic (180 r/s) and a stress spike (burst to 650 r/s for 2m). We used model 'redwood-alike-3b:v1' on dedicated pool. Raw data in the S3 link: https://s3.company/internal/poc/edgeburst/2175/results.tar.gz

sam-eng: grabbing the artifact now. Can you paste the k6/locust command you used? makes repro easier.

edgeburst-rep: Sure — we used a simple k6 script, main bits below:

```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 5m --vus-max 650 script.js
// script.js: POST /v1/generate with prompt payload, 256 max_tokens, stream=false
```

akari-eng: Quick high-level from my run-through of the logs:
- Steady-state (180 r/s): p50=28ms, p95=142ms, p99=310ms, error rate <0.05%
- Spike (650 r/s sustained 2m): p50=35ms, p95=420ms, p99=1.4s, errors ~1.2% (mostly connection timeouts to a few pods)
- Observed queueing at the load-balancer at ~480 r/s — autoscaler scale-up lag ~20s before additional pods were usable.

maria-se: Good notes. Two things for sales copy: 1) what should we state as "expected p95 for 256-token gen under reserved capacity"? 2) Any simple mitigation we can promise if they see tail spikes?

sam-eng: For committed/dedicated capacity we can confidently say: p95 ~150ms for 256-token gen under steady throughput patterns up to the committed QPS. Add a caveat: spikes above commit will increase tail latencies and may hit queueing; recommend burst capacity or autoscale policy tuned to max spike duration.

akari-eng: Mitigations we can offer to the prospect:
- Autoscale tuning: reduce scale-up cooldown to 10s for bursty workloads
- Burst capacity pool (warm warm-up) to handle short spikes without cold starts
- Prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts (can cut p95 by ~40% in tests)

beth-sales: Can we give them a one-liner SLA-friendly statement like: "Under a dedicated pool sized for your sustained QPS, expect p95 latency ~150ms (256-token gen); brief spikes may increase p99 but can be mitigated with burst capacity."?

sam-eng: That phrasing is fine. Add: "Measured on 3B-class model profile; results vary by model size / token length."

edgeburst-rep: Also worth flagging cost/throughput tradeoff we saw: when we enabled int8 quantization on the smaller fallback model (redwood-lite-1.4b-quant), p95 dropped to ~120ms at same cost but output quality differences noted on certain prompts. They asked about automatic fallback for quality vs cost — are we recommending auto-fallback?

akari-eng: Recommend manual policy by default (customer chooses when to fallback). We can enable auto-fallback with constraints: max-quality-drop threshold + token-limit window. We'll need to document expected deltas in quality for their eval set before enabling auto-fallback in prod.

maria-se: For the security thread: SQA asked if load tests touch any PII. EdgeBurst says they used synthetic prompts. We should add a line to the report clarifying that no customer data was used.

beth-sales: Good call — edgeburst-rep please confirm synthetic-only.

edgeburst-rep: Confirmed: synthetic prompts only, no PII, logs scrubbed.

deploy-bot: autoscaler event: scaled from 6 -> 12 pods @ 2175000115 (policy cooldown=20s)

akari-eng: Action items from eng side:
- (sam) Draft the p95/p99 blurb for sales + one-sentence mitigation -> by EOD 2175000100
- (akari) Add short runbook snippet on autoscale tuning + burst pool config -> by 2175000200
- (maria) Add the PII confirmation line to the security append -> by 2175000150

sam-eng: Drafted blurb below — please thumbs-up or suggest edits:
"Under a dedicated pool sized for your sustained throughput, expect p95 latency of ~150ms for a 256-token generation (measured on a 3B-class model). Short spikes above committed QPS may increase p99 latency; we recommend configuring burst capacity or faster autoscale cooldowns to limit tail latency impact."

beth-sales: LGTM :thumbsup: I'll include that in the customer email and pair with the S3 artifacts.

maria-se: Security line: "POC runs used synthetic prompts only; no customer data or PII was processed." OK to add.

edgeburst-rep: One more ask from prospect: can you show a quick comparison graph of steady vs spike for p95/p99? I can add to the deck if you give the numbers.

akari-eng: I'll export a tiny CSV with p50/p95/p99 for both profiles and drop it in the same S3 path by 2175000250. Format: scenario,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms

edgeburst-rep: Thanks — that will help close.

beth-sales: Perfect. If eng deliverables land on time we can send the consolidated recap and next steps by tomorrow morning. :rocket:

sam-eng: Noted. I'll post the final blurb and link to the runbook when ready.
